successors.name: Kingdom of France (Bourbon Restoration and July Monarchy)
successors.text: the island of Mayotte (Maore): Grande-Terre and Petite-Terre, 374 km2

ledger.x: 1500: the Maore sultanate is established on the island ('In 1500, the Maore sultanate was established on the island').
1841: Andriantsoly sells the island to France ('Mayotte was purchased by France in 1841').
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of France (Bourbon Restoration and July Monarchy)

ledger.x: 1841: the sultanate ends with the sale to France.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of France (Bourbon Restoration and July Monarchy)

certainty.note: Island only; 1832-1836 was contested by Andriantsoly, Mwali and Ndzuwani (Anjouan), who each held it briefly.
